title: Collection Escape Hatch
user: An API developer moving a team off Postman who needs to prove that collections, environments, auth, scripts, and examples survived the move before changing the team's daily client.
smallest_useful_product: A local CLI that reads Postman v2.1 plus one target export (initially Bruno/Hoppscotch), checks requests, folders, variables, auth, scripts, examples, and body sizes, then emits a Markdown/JSON migration report.
constraints: Must run fully locally; redact secret values while preserving variable names and structure; track Postman and target-format licenses and schemas.
